note: One record per unique root cause (manifesto §0). Root-cause families RC-01…RC-08 cover the product-owner design rejection; COR-DEF-* records are concrete defects found and closed during this phase.

families.title: Shell and navigation without personality
families.observed: Flat full-height sidebar / plain header strip on a cream canvas; active entry a faint tint (before frames, all 82 pages).
families.root_cause: Shared AppShell and navigation styled once for all eight accounts; no scoped experience layer existed.
families.fix: Experience scope on <html> for the five accounts; floating sidebar panel with filled active pill; Super Administrator Deep Earth header capsule with pill groups; refined tokens.

families.title: Generic page header + card stack
families.observed: Every page opened with the same boxed header and a vertical stack of equal cards.
families.root_cause: SvPageHeader/SvCard were the only composition primitives; no layout vocabulary for splits, rails, feature panels.
families.fix: Editorial header treatment (wash, eyebrow dot, large title) and the sv-r composition kit (splits, rails, feature panels, notes, steps).

families.title: Records as flat rows or clickable cards
families.observed: Lists rendered as identical cards or full-width buttons with a status word.
families.root_cause: No ledger, lane, timeline or ticket anatomy in the design system.
families.fix: Ledger (column band, hover rows, md column headers), lifecycle lanes, timelines, ticket and spine records, queue rows.

families.title: Undifferentiated KPI grid
families.observed: Dashboards and summaries as four equal tiles.
families.root_cause: Single tile primitive with no hierarchy.
families.fix: Dark feature panel leading an asymmetric split; SvKpiCard with tone, icon and drill-through; per-currency statement cards.

families.title: Forms as one long column
families.observed: Setup, profile, availability and compensation forms as an undivided field list.
families.fix: Grouped fieldsets with toned legends, numbered steps, preview rails, identity cards beside editable fields.

families.title: States without design
families.observed: Empty and error states as grey text in a bordered box.
families.fix: State classes on SvStateBoundary/SvEmptyState and a soft icon-well panel in the refined experience.

families.title: Detail pages as label/value lists
families.observed: Account, merchant, staff, invoice and compensation details as two-column definition lists.
families.fix: Dark identity cards, statement documents, numbered contract clauses, fact strips.

families.title: Dialogs and toasts without layering
families.observed: Flat white sheet over a flat scrim.
families.root_cause: Overlays shared one presentation with all accounts.
families.fix: Refined dialog sheet (blurred scrim, hairline, radius-shell, float shadow, warm heading wash, sunken footer, rise-in under no-preference) and refined toasts; markup and focus behaviour unchanged.

defects.observed: Finance exports showed '0 rows' for a processing export whose row_count is null.
defects.evidence: populated capture merchant_finance.exports (pre-fix frame reviewed in session).
defects.root_cause: Template used `row_count ?? 0`, fabricating a zero the server never reported (pre-existing in UI-12).
defects.fix: Render 'Not counted yet' when row_count is null.
defects.tests: npx vitest run pages/finance (45 passed); populated capture re-run

defects.observed: Raw ISO timestamps on the Finance adjustments ledger and the Super Administrator preferred-fee rules.
defects.root_cause: Templates interpolated the server string directly instead of the Nairobi formatter.
defects.tests: npx vitest run pages/finance pages/platform (45 + 191 passed)

defects.observed: HR compensation detail named the commission rule by its ULID.
defects.root_cause: The rule description lived as a local function in Compensation.vue only.
defects.fix: Extracted describeCommissionRule() into the store (display only) and used it on both pages; no duplicated logic.
defects.tests: npx vitest run pages/hr stores/compensationStore (86 passed)

defects.observed: Finance cash-up variance wrapped onto two lines at 1440.
defects.root_cause: A redundant inline 'Variance' label inside a narrow ledger column.
defects.fix: Label visible only below md (sr-only at md+), matching the expected/counted cells.

defects.observed: The UI-16 visual negative control recoloured `.sv-operational-hero`, which no longer renders on the Finance dashboard.
defects.root_cause: The redesigned dashboard replaced the hero with the refined feature panel, so the control would perturb nothing and fail for the wrong reason.
defects.fix: Control now recolours `.sv-r-feature`; verified FAILING the comparison as intended (UI-16 suites 78/78).

defects.observed: vue-tsc: QueueReadOnly lanes Map keyed by string passed to queueStatusLabel(QueueEntryStatus).
defects.root_cause: Wave D lane grouping typed its key too loosely.
defects.fix: Key typed as the entry status union.

defects.observed: Internal platform access table overflowed inside a split layout at 1440.
defects.root_cause: A wide roster table placed in the narrow main column of a split.
defects.fix: Stacked layout with the privileges note first.

defects.observed: Full Playwright: payment.spec.ts › 'hides the override control without the capability and shows no receipt/validate action' failed — the page body contained 'validate'/'receipt'.
defects.root_cause: The redesigned decision rail always rendered its 'What each decision does' note, exposing checker vocabulary to a viewer who cannot decide (a UX regression against the UI-12/Phase 18A contract).
defects.fix: The note renders only when the user has a decision open (`canDecide`); a viewer sees neutral copy.
defects.tests: npx vitest run src/pages/payments (9 passed); payment.spec.ts re-run on the rebuilt source — see test-matrix.json

defects.observed: Full Playwright: phase-20a-billing.spec.ts › plans and prices tests timed out looking for the 'Prices & entitlements' button.
defects.root_cause: The redesign renamed the plan selector's accessible name per page ('Price schedule' / 'Entitlements'), breaking the Phase 20A contract.
defects.fix: Both pages keep the original visible and accessible label 'Prices & entitlements' (no aria-label mismatch, WCAG 2.5.3).
defects.tests: CommercialPages.spec.ts passed; phase-20a-billing.spec.ts re-run on the rebuilt source — see test-matrix.json

defects.observed: Full Playwright: phase-23-release-audit axe failed color-contrast on many refined pages; measured colours were blends (e.g. orange #e46b17 / #f97e29 instead of token #F97316, muted #8f96a2 instead of token #9CA3AF), ratios 4.12–4.49.
defects.root_cause: The refined entrance animation faded opacity 0→1; the release audit does not force reduced motion, so axe sampled every text and button mid-fade, blended with the canvas. The token pairs themselves meet AA at rest.
defects.fix: sv-refined-rise is transform-only (translateY), so every frame renders full token colour; still disabled under reduced motion.
defects.tests: phase-23-release-audit axe re-run on the rebuilt source — see test-matrix.json

defects.observed: Full Playwright: REM-SCR-002B branch calendar determinism (2 tests) found no `row` for the created exception; axe definition-list/dlitem on the HR dashboard and subscription invoice detail.
defects.root_cause: The redesign changed SEMANTICS, not just look: calendar exceptions became a plain list (the contract reads table rows/cells), the HR readiness dl wrapped dt/dd in an extra div, the invoice totals dl nested the date grid inside it. The compensation contract clauses had a non-dt/dd child too (found by inspection).
defects.fix: Calendar tiles carry ARIA table semantics (table/row/cell + hidden column headers); dl groups hold only dt/dd (decorative bar as an aria-hidden dd, dates in their own dl, clause number inside the dt).
defects.tests: re-run of phase-23-release-audit, ui-09, ui-11, rem-dep-003, ui-16 axe; new populated axe sweep (82 pages × light 1440 + dark 360) — see test-matrix.json

defects.observed: Full Playwright: account pages overflowed at 1025px (scrollWidth 1115/1157 > 1025) in ui-09, ui-10 and the UI-16 sweep; Branch read-only invoices lost the `main article` record card the UI-10 contract measures.
defects.root_cause: The account grid went two-column on a viewport breakpoint although the floating sidebar leaves ~677px of content at 1025px, so the sessions table overflowed; the finance read view rendered records as list items only.
defects.fix: Account grid and all kit grids use the `sv-main` container query (two-column from 52rem / 56rem of real content); Branch financial records are <article> elements inside the ledger list.

defects.observed: Full Playwright: 'active navigation stays AA through both theme transitions' measured a 1:1 midpoint; UI-16 first-paint test expected the standard light canvas.
defects.root_cause: The refined nav entry (and pill actions) re-introduced a background-color transition while the text colour switches instantly — the defect UI-16 had closed. The first-paint assertion encoded the standard canvas, not the refined linen canvas the owner-directed redesign introduces.
defects.fix: Nav entries and pill actions transition transform only. The UI-16 test asserts the refined light canvas (rgb 245 243 239) for the five accounts and the standard one elsewhere — still failing any dark first paint.

defects.observed: Full Playwright: 200% CSS-zoom overflow in phase-20e/20f/20g/20h; platform access overflowed 5px at 1025px.
defects.root_cause: At 2x CSS zoom a 1280px desktop lays out in 640 CSS px while media queries still report desktop: the refined top bar sits in the content column with a non-wrapping utility cluster, page actions were set not to shrink, kit grids keyed off the viewport, and pill actions could not shrink. The access roster's panel padding pushed a six-column table over at exactly 1025px.
defects.fix: At desktop media the top bar may wrap (location truncates first, 12rem basis); page actions may shrink/wrap; kit grids answer to the content container; pill actions cap at 100%; access roster panels use compact padding. Measured with a temporary diagnostic (deleted): 0px overflow on five accounts at 2x zoom. Visual baselines unchanged (107/107 compare-only).
